name: Shokutaku Dining
description: Shokutaku Dining is a hospitality theme for a neighbourhood restaurant on Havenstraat in Rotterdam, open since 2014 for weekday lunch and unhurried dinner. The sample copy gives forty seats around an open kitchen, three sittings, six priced menus in euro, a private room for eight to twelve guests, seven named people and four kitchen notes. A greige wall holds a lead title and a booking button beside an arch-topped photograph with an info bar of hours and address, then a 320px white ghost word over three scattered arch photographs, the sittings, a full-bleed room photograph with parallax, a price list, a pill-shaped dish strip that runs off the page, the people, the visit block and a booking close. A tall vertical reservation tab stays at the right edge. Fraunces for display, Source Sans 3 for reading. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; reveals and parallax stop under reduced motion.
